title: Distinct Administrator Login Layout + Admin Access Screen Polish

requirements.text: Create a distinct Administrator login/access screen layout (separate from Parent/Child user flows) for the admin password gate step shown when an authenticated admin has not yet passed the gate.

quotes: o loguin de adiministrador é diferente de PAI/MÃE e FILHO. faça o loguin do administrador com um novo layout
sim, gere com base no que eu falei mas aperfeiçoe oque conseguir

acceptanceCriteria: When `isAdmin === true` and `isGatePassed === false`, the app renders an Administrator-specific access screen with a noticeably different layout/visual styling from the Parent/Child screens.

The Administrator access screen continues to use the existing admin password verification flow (no loss of functionality: verify password, allowlisted password change tab, show/hide password toggles, success/error toasts).
The Parent and Child experiences (including their dashboards and general app shell) remain unchanged in behavior.

requirements.text: Ensure all user-facing text added/changed for the Administrator login/access screen is sourced via the existing i18n system and has English strings (and pt-BR equivalents where the app already supports both).

quotes: faça o loguin do administrador com um novo layout

acceptanceCriteria: No hard-coded Portuguese-only strings are introduced in the new/updated Administrator access screen UI; strings are pulled from the i18n translation dictionaries.
English translations exist for any new keys used by the Administrator access screen.

constraints: Do not edit files under `frontend/src/components/ui` or any other paths listed in `frontend.immutablePaths`.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo`; add `backend/migration.mo` only if persisted state must change.
nonGoals: Adding new authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
Introducing external databases or third-party analytics services.
